features: AI Engine (YOLO Object Detection, OCR, Embedding)
Standardized Gis Metadata Normalization (Automated persistence mapping)
FIFO Metadata Cache (High-performance large dataset parsing)
Rust-powered Core Geometry Engine (Topological validation, high-precision snapping)
Real-time Frontend Topology Guard (Visual self-intersection alerts)
Resizable Table Columns for Statistics Grid
Advanced Line-Clamp Logic for Data Grids
Comprehensive Project Export (ZIP: Excel, KML, Images)
Real-time Export Progress Tracking (Zustand + Modal UI)
Optimized IPC Binary Transfer (Direct Uint8Array invoke)
Natural STT Sorting (Numerical order for alphanumeric markers like C1, C10)
STT-Aware Search (Filtering by serial number or junction code)

Standalone Dialog Architecture (Analysis/Print dialogs as separate Tauri windows)

patterns: Stability-Aware Synchronization
Safe IPC Communication via Tauri Invoke
Lazy Loading AI Models to save RAM
Selection State Coexistence: Allowing multiple selection contexts
Memoized Recursive Hierarchy Logic: Optimizing deep object trees via internal computation caches in hooks.
Adaptive Vertex Editing UX: Automatic handle activation on selection for vector features (Google Maps style).
Visual Response Snapping: Using pulse animations to indicate magnetic point-to-segment lock.
Deferred Deletion Pattern: Decoupling triggering action from execution via custom modals
On-Demand Snapshotting: Saving state periodic/manually to optimize Event Sourcing bottlenecks.
Debounced Multi-Provider Sync: Bundling rapid UI changes before sending to Firestore for cost/performance optimization.
Tauri v2 Multi-window Permissions: Explicitly enabling window/webview creation in capabilities.
Absolute URL Routing: Using window.location.origin for secondary Tauri windows to ensure consistency.
Nested Metadata Persistence: Ensure nested fields (gis, media) are explicitly mapping during normalization to prevent data loss.
Type-Aware Spatial Deduplication: Restricting spatial filtering to same-type entities to preserve dense multi-layer infrastructure mapping.
Virtual Junction Pattern: Using parent_feature_id to group diverse survey data under a physical infrastructure node.
Dynamic Map Context Actions: Adjusting drawing modes and state based on the current selected parent feature.
Line-Clamp Resilience: Using -webkit-box and block display for EditableText to ensure consistent multi-line truncated rendering.
Interactive Column Resizing: Global mouse listener pattern for smooth table adjustment without layout shifts.
Tauri Binary Persistence: Using invoke('save_binary_file') with Uint8Array to handle large file saves, bypassing browser download limitations.
Global Progress Orchestration: Using a dedicated Zustand store (useExportStore) to decouple long-running services from specific UI components.
Diacritic-insensitive Matching (removeVietnameseTones): Converting strings to base characters for resilient search.
Alphanumeric Natural Sort (localeCompare with numeric:true): Ensuring correct sequence for mixed string-number keys like '1.10' or 'C2'.
Hybrid Header Dragging: Combining `data-tauri-drag-region` for static areas and `getCurrentWebviewWindow().startDragging()` for reactive elements.
Window Control Self-Hosting: Frameless windows must implement own Minimize/Maximize/Close logic using Tauri webviewWindow API.
gotchas: WGPU context locks after panic - requires remount
f32 precision issues in deep zoom - use f64 for coordinates
Coordinate JSON parsing safety in Leaflet components
Linker LNK2038 mismatch: MSVC project MUST use Dynamic CRT (MD)
Hierarchical Map Visibility: Child elements hidden when parent icon is visible.
Box Selection Duplication: Ensure unique IDs in setBoxSelection.
Rust Type Inference (rusqlite): MUST provide explicit type annotations (e.g., Row::get::<_, String>(0)) or use explicit variable types to avoid E0282/E0277.
Rust Module Shadowing: Local variables named `state` can shadow the `state` module, causing E0423/E0425.
Redundant marker transforms: CSS transforms on custom Leaflet divIcons can conflict with internal position calculations (Pegman marker offset fix).
Tauri v2 Deny-by-default: Sub-window features will fail silently without explicit permission in capabilities/default.json.
State-Preview Conflict: Must clear temporary preview metadata (setPreview(null,null)) after a successful SAVE to ensure UI consistency.
GIS selection tolerance: Using 100m for deduplication is extreme for urban areas; 2m is recommended for infrastructure density.
Parent Feature State Leak: activeParentFeatureId MUST be explicitly reset when deselecting or closing panels to avoid accidental cross-associations.
Excel Header Fuzzy Matching: Importers should use regex (e.g., /tên|name/i) for better resilience to varied source naming.
Inline-block Wrapping issue: Using inline-block on span prevents line-clamp-2 from working correctly; must use block display.
Excel 32k Cell Limit: Excel cells cannot exceed 32767 characters. Large coordinates or descriptions must be truncated to prevent app crashes during export.
IPC JSON Overhead: Converting large binary data to JSON arrays for Tauri invoke causes massive memory spikes; always use Raw Binary (Uint8Array) if possible.
Optimistic State Pinning: Markers must follow `previewCoords` directly to avoid drag jitters or stuck positions during controlled component renders.
Selection-Edit State Conflict: Stores must explicitly persist `editingFeatureId` through selection events to maintain tool visibility for LineString/Polygon types.
Tauri Window Permission Drift: Permissions like `core:window:allow-start-dragging` or `core:window:allow-minimize` must be manually added to capabilities/default.json or specific permission files.
Window Shadow ID Conflict: Closing a standalone window by label and reopening it too fast can lead to 'Label already exists' errors; use await win.destroy() before creation.
